AcousticCheckCard.description:
Sound-insulation (Schallschutz) gauges — direction-aware dB checks.

Emit for Schallschutz questions (OIB 5). One gauge per building-part pair:
airborne (DnTw, higher is better) and impact (LnTw, lower is better) shown
with opposite orientation so the margin is unmistakable. Measured values
come from the Bauphysik report; unknown → needs_input.
AcousticCheckCard.title: AcousticCheckCard

AcousticCheckItem.description: One sound-insulation check between two building parts.

check.description: Measured vs required in dB (comparator differs by metric)

reference.description: Source of the dB limit (OIB 5 / ÖNORM B 8115-2)

AcousticCheckItem.title: AcousticCheckItem

BuildingSectionCard.description:
A to-scale building cross-section (schematic) drawn from storey heights.

Emit for height/Gebäudeklasse/Fluchtniveau questions where seeing the
building against threshold lines helps (e.g. 'liege ich unter der GK4-Grenze?
Fluchtniveau bei 9,8 m'). Draws stacked storeys, the ground line, and dashed
marker lines (Fluchtniveau, GK/Hochhaus limits) with labels.
BuildingSectionCard.title: BuildingSectionCard

DaylightIncidenceCard.description:
A daylight (Belichtung) schematic: the 45° free-light line vs obstructions.

Emit for daylight/Belichtung questions (OIB 3). Draws a window section, the
45° free-light-incidence line from the window's lower edge, any obstruction,
and a glass-area-vs-floor-area check. The renderer does the 45° geometry —
the model supplies distances/heights only.

obstruction.description: Any object intruding into the 45° light cone

DaylightIncidenceCard.title: DaylightIncidenceCard

DensityCheckCard.description:
A site-density schematic: parcel + footprint + coverage/density bars.

Emit for Bebauungsdichte/Bebauungsgrad/GFZ questions. Draws the parcel with
the footprint shaded and two limit bars (built area / parcel and BGF /
parcel) vs the Bebauungsplan limits. The renderer computes the ratios — the
model supplies areas + the limits (from the user's Bebauungsplan) only.

coverage.description: Bebauungsgrad (built/parcel) vs limit; value null = renderer derives

density.description: GFZ (BGF/parcel) vs limit; null value = renderer derives

reference.description: Source of the limits (usually the Bebauungsplan)

DensityCheckCard.title: DensityCheckCard

DimensionCheck.description:
One measured dimension drawn on a schematic and checked against a limit.

`value` is the project's actual measurement (drawn to scale); `required` is
the OIB limit. If `value` is unknown, leave it null and set status
'needs_input'.

comparator.description: How actual must relate to required
comparator.title: Comparator

unit.description: Unit for both value and required, e.g. 'cm', 'm', '%'
unit.title: Unit

DimensionCheck.title: DimensionCheck

DimensionDiagramCard.description:
A parametric accessibility/geometry schematic with dimension arrows.

Emit for clearance questions (door width, ramp gradient, turning circle,
corridor width, threshold). The renderer picks a prebuilt template for
`shape` and draws each dimension arrow where it is measured, coloured by
status — preventing the Stocklichte-vs-Durchgangslichte misread.

dimensions.description: The measured dimensions to annotate on the schematic
dimensions.title: Dimensions

reference.description: Source of the dimension limits (e.g. OIB 4 / ÖNORM B 1600)

DimensionDiagramCard.title: DimensionDiagramCard

EgressDiagramCard.description:
A schematic escape-route (Fluchtweg) path with the total length checked.

Emit for escape-route-length questions ('ist der Fluchtweg mit 12 m + 26 m
zulässig?'). Draws the path segment-by-segment from the worst-case point to
the exit and checks the total against the OIB 2 limit (typically 40 m).

segments.description: Path runs from the worst-case point to the exit, in order
segments.title: Segments

total_length.description: Sum of segment lengths vs the OIB limit (e.g. <= 40 m)

EgressDiagramCard.title: EgressDiagramCard

EgressSegment.description: One straight run of an escape path, drawn end-to-end with the next.

length_m.description: Run length in metres (drawn to scale)
length_m.title: Length M

EgressSegment.title: EgressSegment

ElevatorRequirementCard.description:
A barrier-free-elevator (Aufzug) card: requirement + cabin dimensions.

Emit for Aufzug / barrierefreie-Erschließung questions (OIB 4). Draws the
served storeys as a stack with a lift shaft, states whether a barrier-free
lift is required (drives from storey count / arrival level), and checks the
cabin and door clear dimensions against the accessibility minimums.

is_required.description: Is a barrier-free lift required? null = unknown
is_required.title: Is Required

reference.description: Source of the lift requirement (OIB 4 / ÖNORM B 1600)

requirement_note.description: Why a lift is / isn't required
requirement_note.title: Requirement Note

storeys_served.description: Number of levels the building has (drawn as a stack)
storeys_served.title: Storeys Served

ElevatorRequirementCard.title: ElevatorRequirementCard

EnergyPerformanceCard.description:
An energy-performance (Energieausweis) card: HWB on the A–G class ladder.

Emit for Energieausweis / Heizwärmebedarf questions (OIB 6). Draws the
A++…G energy-class ladder with the building's class highlighted, and reads
the Heizwärmebedarf (kWh/m²a) against the required maximum. fGEE optional.

hwb.description: Heizwärmebedarf kWh/(m²a) vs the max (lower is better, '<=')

EnergyPerformanceCard.title: EnergyPerformanceCard

EnvelopeComponent.description: One thermal-envelope component with its U-value checked against a limit.

kind.description: Where it sits in the section
kind.title: Kind

u_value.description: U-Wert W/(m²K) vs the max U-value (lower is better, '<=')

EnvelopeComponent.title: EnvelopeComponent

FireAccessPlanCard.description:
A fire-brigade access (Feuerwehrzufahrt) site plan schematic.

Emit for fire-access questions (OIB 2 / TRVB). Top-down plan: access route
from the road, the Aufstellfläche beside the facade, and the reach distance
from the Aufstellfläche to the farthest necessary entrance (typically
<=80 m). Numeric minimums vary by Land — always corpus-grounded per check.

reference.description: Source of the access requirements (OIB 2 / TRVB)

route_width.description: Zufahrt clear width (m) vs the minimum

FireAccessPlanCard.title: FireAccessPlanCard

FireCompartment.description: One Brandabschnitt (fire compartment) drawn as a band, area-checked.
FireCompartment.title: FireCompartment

FireCompartmentCard.description:
A fire-compartment (Brandabschnitt) plan: a storey split into compartments.

Emit for Brandabschnitt questions (OIB 2): draws the storey outline divided
into compartments (width proportional to area) separated by Brandwände, each
read against the maximum permitted Brandabschnittsfläche for its use and
Gebäudeklasse. The limit varies by use/GK — always corpus-grounded.

compartments.description: The compartments on this level, left-to-right
compartments.title: Compartments

storey_label.description: Which level the plan shows, e.g. '2.OG'
storey_label.title: Storey Label

FireCompartmentCard.title: FireCompartmentCard

GuardrailCheckCard.description:
An Absturzsicherung (guardrail) elevation with the interacting limits.

Emit for guardrail/railing questions (OIB 4). Draws the railing to scale and
checks height (>=100 cm, >=110 cm where Absturzhöhe > 12 m), max opening
(<=12 cm cube), bottom gap, and shades the no-climb zone.

fall_height.description: Absturzhöhe (m) — decides which height limit applies

has_horizontal_elements_in_climb_zone.title: Has Horizontal Elements In Climb Zone

max_opening.description: Largest opening (cm) vs the <=12 cm cube rule

GuardrailCheckCard.title: GuardrailCheckCard

LegalBasisCard.description: A legal norm, regulation, or OIB Richtlinie that grounds the answer.

law.description: Name of the law, regulation, or OIB Richtlinie
law.title: Law

original_text.description: Literal excerpt from the source, if available
original_text.title: Original Text

summary.description: Plain-language summary of the legal relevance
summary.title: Summary

LegalBasisCard.title: LegalBasisCard

NormReference.description:
A verifiable pointer into a regulation (the atom of grounding).

Every required value MUST carry one so the architect can verify it against
the source. Never fabricate a reference.

excerpt.description: Literal quoted sentence grounding the value (<= ~200 chars)
excerpt.title: Excerpt

NormReference.title: NormReference

Obstruction.description: An object blocking daylight (opposing building, own projection).

distance_m.description: Horizontal distance from the window in metres
distance_m.title: Distance M

height_m.description: Height of the obstruction above the window sill in metres
height_m.title: Height M

Obstruction.title: Obstruction

ParkingRequirementCard.description:
A parking-provision (Stellplatznachweis) card: required vs provided count.

Emit for Stellplatz / Fahrradabstellplatz questions (Bauordnung /
Stellplatzverordnung). Draws a slot grid — outline slots for the required
count, filled for those provided — and reads provided against the required
minimum for cars and, optionally, bicycles.

basis.description: How the requirement is derived, e.g. '1 Stpl. je 100 m² BGF'
basis.title: Basis

reference.description: Source of the parking requirement (Bauordnung / StPl-VO)

ParkingRequirementCard.title: ParkingRequirementCard

ProjectProfilePatchCard.description: A reviewable patch (add/replace/remove) against a project profile.
ProjectProfilePatchCard.title: ProjectProfilePatchCard

ProjectProfilePatchOperation.description: A JSON Patch operation targeting a project profile section.
ProjectProfilePatchOperation.title: ProjectProfilePatchOperation

ProjectProfilePatchPreviewItem.description: A before/after preview for a single patched field.
ProjectProfilePatchPreviewItem.title: ProjectProfilePatchPreviewItem

SectionMarker.description: A horizontal reference line at a given height in the section.

height_m.description: Height above ground datum in metres
height_m.title: Height M

SectionMarker.title: SectionMarker

SectionStorey.description: One storey in a building cross-section, drawn as a band to scale.

height_m.description: Clear storey height in metres (drawn to scale)
height_m.title: Height M

SectionStorey.title: SectionStorey

SetbackPlanCard.description:
A top-down site plan (schematic): parcel, footprint, and setback envelopes.

Emit for Abstandsflächen/Bauwich questions ('hält das Gebäude die Abstände
ein?'). Draws the parcel, the required-setback envelope, and the building
footprint, with a distance arrow per side coloured by status.

parcel_depth_m.description: Parcel depth in metres (drawn to scale)
parcel_depth_m.title: Parcel Depth M

parcel_width_m.description: Parcel width in metres (drawn to scale)
parcel_width_m.title: Parcel Width M

SetbackPlanCard.title: SetbackPlanCard

SetbackSide.description: A required distance from the building footprint to one parcel edge.

actual_m.description: Actual distance in metres; null if unknown
actual_m.title: Actual M

SetbackSide.title: SetbackSide

StairDiagramCard.description:
A staircase drawn to scale (schematic section) with step-geometry checks.

Emit for stair questions (e.g. 'passt eine Treppe mit 17 Stufen, 18 cm
Steigung, 27 cm Auftritt, 100 cm breit?'). Draws the step profile to scale
and checks riser/going/width and the comfort rule (2×Steigung + Auftritt ≈
59–65 cm) against OIB 4.

comfort_note.description: Result of the 2×Steigung + Auftritt comfort check
comfort_note.title: Comfort Note

riser_count.description: Number of steps in the flight (drawn)
riser_count.title: Riser Count

riser_height.description: Steigung (rise) per step; typical limit <= 18 cm

tread_depth.description: Auftritt (going) per step; typical limit >= 28 cm

width.description: Nutzbare Laufbreite; limit depends on Gebäudeklasse

StairDiagramCard.title: StairDiagramCard

SummaryCard.description: A concise overview of the answer for the user.

title.description: Short title for the summary card
title.title: Title

SummaryCard.title: SummaryCard

ThermalEnvelopeCard.description:
A thermal-envelope (Wärmeschutz) schematic: U-values per building part.

Emit for U-Wert / Wärmeschutz questions (OIB 6). Draws a simple building
cross-section with each envelope component highlighted by status, and one
limit bar per component reading its U-value against the maximum permitted
(lower is better). Fills the OIB 6 energy-efficiency domain.

reference.description: Source of the max U-values (OIB 6 / ÖNORM B 8110-1)

ThermalEnvelopeCard.title: ThermalEnvelopeCard
